answer.book: Latin philosophical treatise by Petrus Poiret (Amsterdam, 1677) in four books (Liber I–IV), preceded by a dedication, a preface (Monenda), an introduction and followed by an index of chapters; each book is divided into numbered chapters, and the chapters of Liber III are headed with numbered attributes.
